summary.text: Preston Stinson is a Republican state representative from Oklahoma House District 96 who took office in November 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, he advanced from the June 16, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Ashtyn Smith.

paragraphs.text: Stinson won the 2020 Republican primary runoff for the District 96 seat, defeating Margaret Best on August 25, 2020, and assumed office on November 18, 2020, succeeding Lewis Moore.
He won the 2022 election without appearing on the ballot after the primary was canceled, and he defeated Steve Herburger in the June 18, 2024 Republican primary.
In the June 16, 2026 Republican primary, Stinson defeated John Bachman, 60.2 percent to 39.8 percent.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists Stinson on the Appropriations and Budget Committee, the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances and the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee.
